user.title: Daikin MPC (shadow mode)
user.description: Map the telemetry entities. Suggested values are pre-filled where they exist. This version only reads and learns; it never writes to the heat pump.

data.predheat_h1: Predheat room forecast +1 h (optional, for comparison)
data.heartbeat: Bridge heartbeat (entity that changes every minute, e.g. Daikin clock)
data.ext_w: External heat pump meter power (W, optional, recommended)
data.ext_kwh: External heat pump meter energy (kWh, optional, recommended)
data.dhw_elec_kwh: Daikin DHW electricity counter (kWh, splits the external meter)

reconfigure.title: Daikin MPC: entity mapping
reconfigure.description: Change which entities are read. Learned state is kept. Empty optional fields are pre-filled with verified defaults where those entities exist.

data.predheat_h1: Predheat room forecast +1 h (optional, for comparison)
data.heartbeat: Bridge heartbeat (entity that changes every minute, e.g. Daikin clock)
data.ext_w: External heat pump meter power (W, optional, recommended)
data.ext_kwh: External heat pump meter energy (kWh, optional, recommended)
data.dhw_elec_kwh: Daikin DHW electricity counter (kWh, splits the external meter)

init.title: Model priors
init.description: Starting values used until learned state exists.
